npc_sefa_priestess.name: Sefa
npc_sefa_priestess.look: A tall, serene woman in her sixties with long silver hair loose down her back, a white wool robe with a blue-dyed hem, a necklace of lake pebbles and bare feet.
npc_sefa_priestess.personality: Serene, curious and devout; sees the Lady of the Lake's hand in every wonder, and is moved by it rather than frightened.
npc_sefa_priestess.values: the Lady of the Lake, wonder, kindness to the poor
npc_sefa_priestess.fears: the Lady's anger, the shrine forgotten
npc_sefa_priestess.authority: Keeps the shrine of the Lady of the Lake.
npc_sefa_priestess.concerns: The shrine's lamp went out in last night's wind and she has no flint: the fire must be lit anew.

lamp.text: The shrine lamp must be lit with new fire, and she has no flint.
lamp.line: The Lady's lamp went out. New fire, it must be, and I have no flint.
lamp.lead: Sefa needs new fire to light the shrine's lamp.

stone.text: The black stone on the altar pulls iron to it: a gift of the Lady, they say.
stone.line: That black stone? It draws iron to itself. The Lady's gift, the old ones said.
stone.lead: The black stone in Sefa's shrine draws iron to it.

npc_sefa_priestess.style: Slow and warm; speaks of the Lady as of a neighbour.

samples: The Lady sends us wonders, if we've eyes for them.
Brann sees witches under every stone, poor man.
voice.habits: Touches her pebble necklace; blesses people; asks how things work, then answers herself.
voice.greeting: Smiles: 'Welcome to the Lady's shore, traveller.'

goals: Relight the shrine lamp with new fire

npc_brann_fisher.text: a good man, too quick to fear

superstition.text: Sefa sees the Lady of the Lake's hand in every wonder, and calls it a blessing.

npc_brann_fisher.name: Brann
npc_brann_fisher.look: A lean, weather-beaten man in his late thirties with black stubble and wary eyes, a knitted grey cap, an oiled smock over a patched shirt, sea boots and a gutting knife at his belt.
npc_brann_fisher.personality: Hard-working, superstitious and quick to fear what he doesn't understand; ashamed of it after. Loyal once he trusts someone.
npc_brann_fisher.values: his catch, his boat, plain things he understands
npc_brann_fisher.concerns: His mother told him of a witch who made fire from water; he watches strangers for anything uncanny. His fish won't dry if the weather turns.

hooks.text: He keeps iron fish hooks and cork floats in his hut.
hooks.line: Hooks and floats? In the hut, on the shelf. Why?
hooks.lead: Brann keeps iron fish hooks and cork floats in his hut.

witch.text: When he was a boy a witch made fire from water at Glasmere, and the village burned her.
witch.line: My mother saw it. A witch made fire out of water. They burned her for it.
witch.lead: Brann believes a witch once made fire from water at Glasmere.

npc_brann_fisher.persuaded_by: seeing how a thing works, step by step, with his own hands
npc_brann_fisher.style: Short, suspicious, plain; crosses himself when scared.

samples: Hm. Well. If it's just glass and sun...
voice.habits: Watches strangers' hands; makes the sign against evil; mends nets.

goals: Keep bad luck off his boat

npc_sefa_priestess.text: holy, but she'd bless a turnip if it glowed

superstition.text: Brann fears witchcraft: anything uncanny he sees done frightens him and turns him against whoever did it, unless he understands how it works.
